quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: In Hungary, it's traditional to celebrate your 'name day' in addition to your birthday. Each day of the year is associated with specific names, and Ildikó's name day is celebrated on November 13th. This double celebration tradition means Hungarians often get twice the cake and twice the well-wishes!

short_read.title: The Secret Language of Trees
short_read.teaser: Scientists have discovered that trees communicate with each other through underground fungal networks, sharing nutrients and even warning each other of danger. It's like a 'wood wide web' beneath our feet!

medium_read.title: The Remarkable Intelligence of Crows
medium_read.teaser: Crows can recognize human faces, use tools, and even hold 'funerals' for their dead. These fascinating birds, common in the Pacific Northwest, are among the smartest creatures on Earth.

long_read.title: The Lost Gardens of Babylon
long_read.teaser: Were the Hanging Gardens of Babylon real or myth? New archaeological evidence suggests these ancient wonders may have actually existed in a different location than previously thought. A captivating mystery from the ancient world unfolds.

port_angeles.title: Harbor Seals of the Strait
port_angeles.description: August is prime time to spot harbor seals hauling out on rocks near Ediz Hook and along the Strait of Juan de Fuca. These gentle marine mammals can often be seen basking in the sun, and the mothers are teaching their pups to hunt and swim this time of year. Bring binoculars for the best views!

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart can beat up to ___ times per minute.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Wonderful! Yes, 1,200 beats per minute — that's about 20 times faster than a human heart!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is 1,200 beats per minute — incredibly fast for such a tiny bird!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: The answer is 1,200 beats per minute! It's hard to imagine a heart beating that fast, but it fuels their amazing hovering flight.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: Hummingbirds have the highest metabolism of all animals, which is why they need to eat about half their body weight in nectar every day. When they sleep, their heart rate can drop to as low as 50 beats per minute to conserve energy.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Perfect! Pillangó is the beautiful Hungarian word for butterfly — doesn't it sound lovely?
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The answer is 'pillangó'! Virág means flower, madár means bird, and napsugár means sunbeam — all beautiful words!
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Hungarian is a unique language in Europe, part of the Finno-Ugric family rather than Indo-European. Its closest linguistic relatives are Finnish and Estonian, making it quite different from neighboring languages.

puzzle_3.question: What type of tree is the oldest living organism on Earth?
puzzle_3.correct_response: Exactly right! Bristlecone pines can live over 5,000 years — the oldest known tree is named Methuselah and is 4,855 years old!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's the Bristlecone Pine! These incredible trees grow in harsh mountain conditions and can live over 5,000 years, making them Earth's oldest living organisms.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: The oldest bristlecone pine, nicknamed Methuselah, grows in California's White Mountains. Its exact location is kept secret to protect it, but it was already ancient when the pyramids were built!
